_about: ALLOWED include scan. Qt Qml in core, Qt Gui in platform, Qt Widgets in the UI, core/types.h everywhere. Expected: PASS. This is the false-positive guard for the Qt rule: if it were written as 'ban anything QML-ish' or 'ban all of Qt Gui', this case would fail.

include_rules.message: a backend file must not include UI code
backend code must not use Qt Widgets, Quick or Graphs
platform adapters must not depend on core services
the UI must use the published component contract, not the component-private implementation headers
